headline: Volume Leadership Intact; Profit Recovery Pushed Out

highlights: Key Points  Topline came in 3.9% below our estimates at Rs27bn, while EBITDA margin expanded by ~172bps YoY to 4.7%, aided by operating leverage from higher volumes and ongoing structural cost optimisation initiatives  UCP: The UCP segment achieved its highest-ever quarterly sales in both value and volume, supported by strong RAC demand and strengthening market leadership.

The management continues to focus on selective order booking, execution discipline and working capital control, targeting sustainable EBIT margins of 4–6.  Voltbek delivered a strong Q2 performance, supported by improving distribution reach and retail visibility.

Maintain HOLD. 2QFY27 performance update: Voltas delivered a steady Q2 FY27 performance, with consolidated revenue growing 15% YoY to Rs27bn and PAT rising 53% to Rs526mn, supported by strong growth in UCP and EPS.
EMPS continued to benefit from a healthy order book of ~Rs68bn, while EPS delivered strong growth across mining and textile machinery.
valuation: The management continues to focus on selective order booking, execution discipline and working capital control, targeting sustainable EBIT margins of 4–6.  Voltbek delivered a strong Q2 performance, supported by improving distribution reach and retail visibility.
Our revised TP is ~36x blended Q2FY29E earnings, (a ~61% discount to the five-year average forward P/E).

CMP: Rs1,099 | Target Price (TP): Rs1,089 | Downside: 0.9% November 7, 2026 Institutional Equities Voltas (India) (VOLT) 2 UCP: Strong Demand Momentum with Margins Poised for Recovery: The UCP segment continued to benefit from strong RAC demand, with Voltas gaining market share to 17.4%, up 1.5pp YoY, and widening its lead over the second-largest player to 4.2pp.
